feedback: Decision: approve. This is the final iteration, so this design is the one scored on the unseen track, and no later revision can be raced. The candidate matches iteration 6 (score 85.60), which iteration 9 reproduced exactly. The one change from iteration 6 is base_speed 1.0 to 1.0 with no difference, so the design is identical to the best raced result. Iteration 10 (base_speed 0.9, score 81.76) shows that 0.9 is worse, so the candidate correctly returns to 1.0. Iteration 7 (kd 0.20) and iteration 8 (sensor spread 0.08 m) both lost badly, so their settings should not be used. Nothing here is a prediction for the candidate. The open issues from earlier races (oval max_error about 0.062, just over the 0.06 m limit, and one line loss each on s-bend and slalom) were not resolved by any recovery direction, speed or sensor change tried, so they are not addressed in this final design. Approving the reproduced best keeps the most reliable known option for the held-back track.
requested_changes: Race entity0 unchanged: base_speed 1.0, kp 4.0, ki 0.05, kd 0.30, sensor weights -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, five 16 mm sensors at x = -0.05, -0.025, 0, 0.025, 0.05 m (y = 0.04 m), line_loss search_left. Evidence: iterations 6 and 9 both scored 85.60, and iteration 10 at 0.9 scored 81.76.
Do not change kd (iteration 7 at 0.20 cut oval progress to 0.115) or sensor spread (iteration 8 at 0.08 m cut oval progress to 0.2039 and collapsed s-bend and slalom).
